text:
devon: Heads up — Acme Bio wants to validate our incident runbook + telemetry mapping tomorrow. Can we quickly confirm what we'll show around RBAC change audits, KMS key access logs, and how we prove chain-of-custody for a demo?

maria: do we have a pared-down checklist we can hand them? they asked for SIEM ingest examples too.

kevin: I put together a minimal mapping in #eng-infra last week. TL;DR: we ship JSON logs to customer SIEM via pub/sub with these fields: tenant_id, request_id, actor_id, action, resource, result, timestamp, key_id (if crypto op). They want examples tho.

maria: perfect. can we show a sample event?

kevin: sure — sample (redacted):

```
{
  "tenant_id": "tenant_42",
  "request_id": "req-9f8a7b",
  "actor_id": "svc:dedicated-gw@redwood",
  "action": "model.generate",
  "resource": "model:redwood/gptx-4",
  "result": "200_ok",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-21T15:04:05Z",
  "key_id": "kms:projects/prod/keys/rdw-key-01",
  "audit_hints": { "kv_cache_hit": false }
}
```

natalie: quick note: for RBAC change audits, we record policy_id, change_author, diff, and approval_ticket in the audit feed. That gets folded into the same JSON stream so customers can correlate a policy change to a later access attempt.

devon: good. Acme will ask about proof that KMS operators didn't unwrap keys during an incident. What artifacts do we present?

kevin: we can share HSM/KMS access logs + KMS admin role change events. For hosted KMS we include: key_op (encrypt/decrypt/unwrap), caller_principal, ip, timestamp, and request_status. For private HSM we show audit trail snapshots and signed manifests.

maria: they also asked about retention/PII in logs. We should confirm we redact prompt text unless customer opts in via contract.

natalie: yes — default is prompt_text: REDACTED in exported logs. We include prompt_hash for QA correlation. Example: prompt_hash: sha256:abcdef...

ir-bot: INCIDENT PLAYBOOK: link to canonical runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-telemetry-playbook (read-only) :rotating_light:

devon: thanks bot. For the call demo I want a short narrative: 1) show RBAC change -> 2) correlated access attempt -> 3) KMS decrypt attempt -> 4) signed audit snapshot export. Can someone draft 3 log lines to walk through?

kevin: draft:
1) RBAC change event:
```
{ "event": "rbac.policy.update", "policy_id": "policy-98", "change_author": "maria", "diff": "+allow svc:dedicated -> model:invoke", "timestamp": "2026-03-20T11:02:00Z" }
```
2) Access attempt after change:
```
{ "event": "authz.check", "actor_id": "svc:dedicated-gw@redwood", "resource": "model:redwood/gptx-4", "result": "allowed", "request_id": "req-9f8a7b", "timestamp": "2026-03-20T11:02:12Z" }
```
3) KMS decrypt (denied/allowed example):
```
{ "event": "kms.key_op", "key_id": "kms:rdw-key-01", "op": "unwrap", "caller": "user:ops-admin", "status": "denied", "timestamp": "2026-03-20T11:02:13Z" }
```

maria: nice. add the prompt_hash in the access attempt payload so they can see audit linking: "prompt_hash": "sha256:..."

kevin: done. also add a signed manifest snippet for chain-of-custody export:
```
manifest_sig: "sig:v1:MEUCIQDx...", manifest_timestamp: "2026-03-20T11:10:00Z"
```

devon: extra ask from Acme yesterday — they want to know how we triage a vuln affecting the runtime that could expose session KV cache. What's our high-level story?

natalie: high-level: 1) isolate affected pool (auto-drain), 2) rotate model-serving keys (ephemeral), 3) backfill cache-miss mode (stateless fallback), 4) notify customers with potential exposure, 5) produce signed audit export showing no key unwrap events during window.

maria: and include remediation timeline SLA we promise for Dedicated customers (48 hours containment, 7-day mitigation window) — mention escalation path.

devon: can we prove containment to auditors? they'll ask for evidence that we didn't query customer prompts during investigation.

natalie: we snapshot access logs + run a read-only audit query against logstore, include hashes of the queries and signed export. That demonstrates chain-of-custody.

maria: I'll assemble a two-slide appendix with examples + links to the runbook and a sanitized log bundle. Anyone want to review before EOD?

kevin: I'll review, focusing on the KMS fields.

devon: thanks all. @ir-bot drop a short checklist for the meeting so we don't forget to show redaction policy and signed manifests.

ir-bot: CHECKLIST CREATED: [Runbook link], [Sanitized log bundle], [RBAC change timeline], [KMS access sample], [Vuln triage timeline] :white_check_mark:

maria: great — I'll ping the customer with the meeting artifacts and the sanitized bundle.

kevin: one last quick note — for the demo script, keep timestamps in RFC3339 and avoid actual tenant IDs (use tenant_redacted).

devon: agreed. see you in the prep call in 30. :thumbsup:
